PluginData.Author: PhoenixTheSage
PluginData.Tooltip: Screen-space contact shadows for Space Engineers point lights (requires Anomaly).
PluginData.Description:
Adds screen-space contact shadows for omni/point lights. Vanilla SE only shadows the sun and up to four spots; this pack darkens only point-light energy at AfterLighting.
Requires the Anomaly Shader Framework. Configure under Anomaly Shaders → Screen Space Shadows → Settings (Rich HUD Master) or the Pulsar plugin dialog.
